base_image.digest_basis: Read by an anonymous GET of https://registry-1.docker.io/v2/library/almalinux/manifests/10 at 2026-10-17T01:14:46Z: an OCI image index whose Docker-Content-Digest is the sha256 of its body, and whose linux/amd64 manifest is the digest the Containerfile names.

budget.basis: Declared, not measured. KIWI documents a minimum of 15 GB recommended free space for the build root, caches and resulting images; the minutes are a declared ceiling below the documented job ceiling. The peak disk and elapsed time of a real build stay unmeasured until the first recipe attempt records them, and this figure must be replaced by that measurement.

container_runtime.basis: The container runtime the optional apps need (appliance/layer/optionalapps): Docker Engine with its CLI and the Compose plugin, and containerd. The image's repositories stay AlmaLinux's two trees and the product's own, so these four RPMs are not a third repository: the stage step downloads exactly these files by sha256 into the per-build repository, after checking each header signature against the vendor key below. Each sha256 is the one the repository's primary metadata names (read 2026-10-23T11:35:17Z, repomd.xml sha256 and primary sha256 in repository) and the one of the downloaded file. Docker publishes no source RPM for rhel/10 at these versions (its source trees stop at 28.4.0), and all four are Apache-2.0, so each entry names the upstream release its version number names, with the commit that release's tag points at (git ls-remote, peeled).

key.basis: https://download.docker.com/linux/rhel/gpg, read 2026-10-19T11:47:48Z. It is the key whose ID C52FEB6B621E9F35 signs the four RPMs below: rpmkeys -K with only this key imported answers 'digests signatures OK' for each of them (measured in an AlmaLinux 10 container, 2026-10-19T11:47:48Z).

distribution.basis_note: Every OS root below takes its NEVRA and sha256 from the pinned primary metadata of the repository named; transitive candidates come only from the same four trees, whose repomd.xml bootstrap.sh checks in dnf's cache before it installs offline. The image's own roots come from the two AlmaLinux trees only; EPEL 10 and CRB serve the builder alone. No other repository is configured.

builder_key.basis: https://dl.fedoraproject.org/pub/epel/RPM-GPG-KEY-EPEL-10, kept beside bootstrap.sh as RPM-GPG-KEY-EPEL-10; its fingerprint is the one https://fedoraproject.org/security/ lists for EPEL 10 (read 2026-10-17T01:16:00Z). It signs the builder-only packages; no image package comes from EPEL.

distribution.edition_basis: the conventional RPM/DNF package base of the RHEL 10 family; the image profile is server/minimal

key.basis: The file almalinux-gpg-keys-10.2-21.el10 (BaseOS) installs, byte-equal to https://repo.almalinux.org/almalinux/RPM-GPG-KEY-AlmaLinux-10; its key ID DEE5C11CC2A1E572 is the one https://almalinux.org/security/ lists for AlmaLinux OS 10 (read 2026-10-17T01:15:00Z).

invocation.invocation_note: A container build of a disk image is privileged: the documented route starts the runtime through sudo, shares host device nodes for loop devices and adds the capabilities above. Non-privileged builds are not possible in container mode, so this toolchain runs only on a disposable runner that shares no host with another build.

probe.probe_note: The probe allocates only the small image above and starts one machine that never leaves prelaunch. It proves accelerator initialization, a toolchain that starts and reports its version, and loop and mount privilege. It proves no guest boot and no image output.

purpose: The exact build toolchain the AlmaLinux 10 appliance image recipe runs, and the prerequisite it proves on a disposable hosted runner before a recipe attempt. This lock builds no image and boots no guest.

resolution.qualification: Source metadata closure only; the hosted builder build, ABI, CLI and required data files must pass before eligibility.
resolution.rejected_route: AlmaLinux 10's python3-kiwi comes from EPEL at 11.1.1, not the locked 11.0.4; it is never installed.

runner.documented_note: Published runner figures are decimal GB. Actual free bytes, processor and memory values are measured; no capacity conclusion follows from the label.

boxed_plugin.reason: The boxed plugin fetches and updates its box images from the Virtualization:Appliances:SelfContained project at run time, which is an implicit latest this lock refuses, and its default mode requires KVM, which a standard hosted runner does not document. This lock uses the documented container route instead: the build host is the same distribution as the target image, which the build host constraints describe as the most compatible case.
